title: Certificates of Deposit: the add-on already made this term, the term count and the room under the term cap
content:
## Scope

When the owner of a Certificates of Deposit certificate asks to move as much as the certificate will take into it as an in-term add-on, this rule identifies any add-on already made in the current term and measures what it leaves of the term's count and of the term cap.

## Condition when the add-on is measured

The certificate whose grace period has ended stands in an active new term when the add-on is measured. A certificate still in grace period status is not measured for an add-on: a renewal starts a new term, and an add-on of the previous term no longer counts once that new term has started.

## Rule

1. **Which add-on is "already made this term".** Because no tier allows more than one add-on per term, the add-on already made in the current term, if any, is the most recent in-term add-on deposit whose posted date is on or after the term start date. An in-term add-on posted before the term start date belongs to an earlier term and is disregarded.
2. **Count.** When such an add-on exists, it counts toward the tier's most add-ons per term; the term's count is used up only once the tier's most add-ons per term have been made.
3. **Term cap room.** The room under the term cap is the tier's most added per term, less the amount of the add-on already made in the current term. With no add-on in the current term, the room is the whole of the tier's most added per term.

## Cases (hypothetical tier allowing 1 add-on and 20000.00 per term; current term started 10 June)

| Most recent in-term add-on on the ledger | Posted on or after 10 June? | Count used up? | Room under the term cap |
|---|---|---|---|
| None | Not applicable | No | 20000.00 |
| 7500.00 posted 3 March, in the previous term | No, disregarded | No | 20000.00 |
| 7500.00 posted 14 June | Yes | Yes, 1 of 1 made | 12500.00 |

## Points of judgement

**The certificate took an add-on last term. After it renewed, does that add-on still use up this term's count?**
No. Only an add-on posted on or after the current term start date counts, and after a renewal the term start date is that of the new term.

**Is the term cap reduced by grace-period deposits?**
No. Only the in-term add-on already made in the current term is taken out of the term cap.
